subject: Mutual Action Scoreboard — Implementation Ownership & Cutover Checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@orbitum.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: priya.singh <priya.singh@orbitum.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & timeline for Orbitum integration

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Orbitum is keen to move forward. We discussed building an initial inference pipeline for our customer support assistant and agreed on a ~10-week launch runway. To keep velocity, can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone owners, key dates, and any gating dependencies (procurement, security review, sandbox credentials)?

High-level asks from our side:
- A cutover date target (we're aiming for 2027-08-15)
- Who will own data onboarding (schema mapping + sample exports)
- Security questionnaire/responsibility for evidence collection (SOC 2 items)

If you can send a scoreboard-style MAP we can align our PT and engineering leads on responsibilities. Attaching our internal rollout window for reference (link in body).

Appreciate it — Jordan

--
Jordan Lee
Head of Product Operations, Orbitum Systems
---
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@orbitum.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orbitum.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & timeline for Orbitum integration

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. I drafted a Mutual Action Scoreboard that lays out milestones, owners, acceptance criteria, and target dates. I attached the MAP (Orbitum-MAP-v1.2.xlsx) and a proposed cutover checklist. Key highlights below:

1) Target cutover: 2027-08-16 (one day buffer from your preferred 08-15) — dependent on SOC evidence sign-off and sandbox load testing.

2) Owner assignments (proposed):
   - Data onboarding (schema & sample ingestion): Orbitum engineering (Priya) / Redwood engineer (Ben Carter) — owner: Priya (customer) / Ben (Redwood BAM).
   - Security evidence & controls: Orbitum security (Jordan) / Redwood compliance lead (Marissa) — owner: Marissa Cole.
   - Runtime validation & perf testing: Redwood runtime (Alex Martinez) / Orbitum SRE — owner: Alex Martinez.
   - CS acceptance & success metrics: Sofia Ivanova / Orbitum PM — owner: Sofia.

3) Milestone cadence: 4 sprints (2 weeks each) for onboarding + 2-week staging/verification window. See MAP sheet 'Timeline' for dates and checkpoints.

4) Procurement & SOW: we'll circulate the SOW (attached) for signature; procurement gating expected in Week 2. If procurement completes by 2027-06-10 we maintain the 08-16 cutover.

Next steps I propose this week:
- Quick alignment call (30m) with Priya, Ben, and Alex to confirm owners and the sandbox intake API (can you do Thu 5/27 10am PT?)
- Orbitum to share schema sample export by Mon 5/31
- Redwood to begin initial environment provisioning after PO or signed SOW

I've kept the MAP in scoreboard format so we can update progress weekly and surface blockers. Let me know if you'd prefer we move the security gating earlier.

Thanks — Sofia

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & timeline for Orbitum integration

Sofia — looping in here with a few operational notes before the Thu alignment call:

- Sandbox credentials: we need Orbitum to whitelist three IP ranges; I'll send details in a follow-up and can provision the sandbox once that's completed.
- Data onboarding: Ben recommends a small canonical dataset (<= 10k rows) for the first pass to validate mapping; Priya, can you confirm sample availability by 5/31?
- Performance targets: Alex, can you confirm we can commit to perf test windows on 7/20-7/22? If yes, we'll flag any performance regressed models by 7/25.

Also attached a short 'Cutover Checklist' inside the MAP workbook. I'll own the environment provisioning tasks and run the staging smoke tests.

—Ben

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orbitum.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@orbitum.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & timeline for Orbitum integration

Thanks, Sofia and team — the MAP looks great and the scoreboard layout will work for our weekly ops sync. Quick confirmations from Orbitum:

- Sample export: I'll upload a canonical dataset (CSV, ~7.2k rows) to the shared Drive by EOD Mon 5/31 and include schema notes.
- IP whitelist: We'll get networking to add the three ranges Ben listed; ETA 5/29.
- Security evidence: Our InfoSec will start compiling SOC artifacts; Marissa, I'll route requests to your team directly.

We accept the adjusted cutover (2027-08-16) and will aim to clear procurement by 2027-06-10. Please go ahead and schedule the Thu 5/27 10am PT call — Priya and I will be on.

Appreciate the concise checklist and ownership table. Looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Priya Singh
Senior Engineering Manager, Orbitum Systems
